OpenBMB VoxCPM2 (2B) — 4-Stage Hierarchical Continuous-Latent Diffusion-AR Pipeline
Downsamples reference audio to 16 kHz (8 kHz Nyquist)
[103, ref_feats, 104] slot isolates timbre from prosody
Supports zero-ref Voice Design & 9 Chinese dialect shifts

Patchify (P=4 frames) -> 6.25 Hz step (160 ms / patch)

Restores 50.88 dB Whisper SDR (+34.8 dB vs coarse discrete)
Causal conv ring buffer hop=1920 (3x upsample -> 48 kHz)
Measured 17.7 kHz BW (+44.4 dB @ 16-24 kHz vs v1.5)
Post-hook AudioSeal invisible watermark + C2PA manifest
Unquantized Continuous Residual Highway (LocEnc -> RALM: preserves inhalations, whispers & sobbing micro-dynamics)
Automatic Streaming Circuit-Breaker Fallback (patch_text_ratio anomaly or hard lexicon -> instant reroute to Azure Speech)
